items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Guard denies python - with a closed but empty (or whitespace-only) heredoc; non-empty heredocs and non-interpreter heredocs stay allowed; constitution, runner prompt and hooks doc updated in the same diff.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Hook stays fail-open (main() catches everything); SHIPWRIGHT_BARE_PYTHON_GUARD=off unchanged.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No secrets, no new inputs; hook only reads the command string.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 4 deny cases incl. the exact subagent command, 2 allow cases, 1 integration test through the registered hook command in a real subprocess; 49 pass.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra pass over already-masked lines; no extra spawns.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: mask() returns a third list (empty); empty_heredocs() mirrors unterminated_heredocs(); file stays under 300 LOC.

items.note: Hook stdin/stdout JSON contract unchanged; CRLF line endings preserved in the three CRLF files.
